name: Watching now
description: Who is watching what in Jellyfin right now, with how far through they are.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

changed: Plainer wording in the text and help pages. How it works has not changed.

**Reaches Starboard on any network:** with Starboard 0.23.0 or later it calls Starboard through a socket in its own folder. So it works on its own closed network too. An older Starboard works as before.
**Clearer words:** the band says **Watching**, and the card lists each person.
**Logo description:** a screen reader says "Watching now logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

fixed: **Jellyfin 12:** it sends Jellyfin's key the way Jellyfin 12 asks for it, so Jellyfin no longer refuses its requests where legacy authorisation is off. Older Jellyfin still works.

changed: **Lighter at rest:** it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second. It writes nothing to its folder when a run goes well.
**Starts faster:** its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins, in the Catalogue and on its dashboard cards.
**Its cards say how things are:** a status and when they last changed, in the grey band at the top of each card.
**Kept up to date:** its card is asked every 30 seconds while the dashboard is open.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.

added: Who is watching what in Jellyfin right now, with how far through they are.
